hypothesis: V69 changed means and regressed. V70-V77 response mean corrections fail discrimination. Keep every realized V66 row total and every gene total EXACTLY, learn only cell variance. NB moment-matched shape bridge at zero mean effect, followed by reviewed V29 exact-margin projection and CPM repair. Related to old fixed-mean variation tests, but protects actual published V66 profiles and uses a count-shape proposal rather than latent neural residuals.
shape: Fit depth-conditioned NB alpha on V66 population and full query NTC controls. Reliable nonpanel genes require >=80 molecules in both. Restore query alpha; learned arm adds quarter of study-balanced V69 source dispersion shift with whole-study exclusion. Shape log-ratio clipped +/-ln4. Mix proposed counts with original at10%/25% before projection. Other genes receive zero shape change. Project to exact original row and column counts; retain original if global CPM drift>0.0005 or movement>15% of original molecules. Undefined alpha uses original; no target treatment input.
controls: Each arm uses the same shaping/rounding seed. Control arms compare alpha shuffled among reliable genes within ten expression bins. Learned arm compares cyclic target-shuffled V69 dispersion evidence at same strength. Zero shape is exact count identity. Existing V29 projector unchanged, including5% CPM repair budget.
development: First TWO unique fixed cases/context (10 populations, PDS>=2). Three arms versus V66 and respective shuffled controls. Profile/PDS must be bitwise identical, CPM bound passes. Select highest fidelity among candidates with fidelity gain>=.002, Jaccard gain>=.0005, reach no worse .005, NMAE available-study error no worse1%, and fidelity/Jaccard better than its shuffled control. Missing studies explicitly remain missing; available NMAE is a partial guard, never full six-metric support.
confirmation: Remaining unique cases after first2 (2/2/4/6/6,20 populations), two seeds0/+620000. No promotion after confirmation. Critical release requires exact raw profiles/PDS, mean CPM bound, fidelity/Jaccard favorable versus V66 and shuffle, reach no material regression, available-study NMAE<=1.01. Corrected expression numerator/jackknife may change and is NOT protected by bulk identity. All public biological data reused; no hidden-score forecast.
